_about: Plugins the kit uses but does not store: they install from their own marketplaces so they keep getting updates. Install a group into a project with: python tools/install_external.py <group> <project folder>. See docs/howto/11-external-plugins.md.

frontend-design.use: UI and front-end that looks designed, not generic

design.use: design critique, design systems, accessibility, UX copy, handoff

website-design.use: websites and landing pages from a written design direction (DESIGN.md), page review

codesign.use: logos and brand assets as editable designs, print PDFs, videos; runs locally

icons8.use: one icon pack and illustration style per project, UI polish and checks

b2b-personal-branding.use: bios, LinkedIn headline and About, positioning, brand narrative
